specs.title: inventory Ops Console through the real browser UI
fails closed with no local connection credentials and exposes diagnostics on demand
turns an authenticated-session 401 into a reauthentication gate
renders the real workspace brand tree with revision and store navigation
ops/tasks long list scrolling keeps page stable (no white-screen)
